name: 暗記と選択と記述の出題形式
prompt:
Create a faithful 390 × 210 px Japanese question-type settings component. Reference 1 is the authoritative Lighthouse native preview for exact wording, spacing, typography and states. Return only this component canvas, without a phone frame or surrounding screen.

The user dislikes tint colors. Make the whole canvas and rounded card interior pure white #FFFFFF; remove all pale mint, lavender, cream, gray or blue tinted fills, gradients, shadows, glow and texture. Preserve the card bounds and 12 px corner radius, with a thin neutral #E5E5E5 outline to keep the group visible on white. Use flat solid forest green #047857 only for the active switch, neutral #E4E4E4 for inactive tracks, and white 22×22 knobs. Text is #1D1D1D.

Match the 390×210 native layout. Card x=16/y=4, 358×202, radius12, white fill and thin neutral outline. Heading “問題の形式” x=32/y=16, 326×16, Meiryo Bold 12/16. Row “暗記カード” x=32/y=58, 252×24, Meiryo Regular 14/24; OFF track x=298/y=56, 54×30, #E4E4E4, white 22×22 knob x=302/y=60 with 11 px corners. Row “選択問題” x=32/y=106, 252×24; ON track x=298/y=104, 54×30, flat solid #047857, white knob x=324/y=108. Row “記述問題” x=32/y=154, 252×24; OFF track x=298/y=152, 54×30, #E4E4E4, white knob x=302/y=156. Preserve the exact Japanese text, three state values, card shape and spacing. Add no extra content or decoration.
reviewNotes: White surface and neutral outline remove tint; fix stray glyph in 選択問題 and flatten switch fills once.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
